quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #15
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: Motorcycles are entitled to:

options.text: The bicycle lane.
The same full lane width as other motor vehicles.
Half the width of a lane.
The width of the sidewalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same full lane width as other motor vehicles.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles need the same full lane width as all other vehicles.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Yield.
Crossroad ahead.
Keep right.
Yield ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield.
questions.explanation: A three-sided sign tells you to slow down at an intersection. Be ready to stop and let other drivers or pedestrians go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: When driving in fog, you should use your high beam headlights.

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: False
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog. High beams bounce back at you and make it harder to see.

questions.question: When driving in fog:

options.text: Use your parking lights.
Use your low beams.
Use your high beams.
It makes no difference which lights you use.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your low beams.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when driving in fog, rain, or snow.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
No left turn.
Merge.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Merge.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes moving in the same direction are about to become one lane.

questions.question: A red and white triangular sign at an intersection means:

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: A red and white triangular yield sign means slow down at the intersection. Let any vehicles or pedestrians go first. Be ready to stop if you need to.

questions.question: If you are driving in another driver's blind spot, you should:

options.text: Move forward or drop back so the other driver can see you.
Keep a steady pace.
Stay in the driver's blind spot.
Honk to let them know you are there.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move forward or drop back so the other driver can see you.
questions.explanation: Do not stay in another driver's blind spot. Move ahead or back so they can see you.

questions.question: A good rule to remember for passing is:

options.text: Pass on the right whenever possible.
Drive with the flow of traffic and pass only as needed.
Try to get to the front of any slow-moving traffic so that you can see better.
Always flash your lights and sound your horn to alert other drivers to your intentions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive with the flow of traffic and pass only as needed.
questions.explanation: Passing other cars increases the chance of a crash. Drive with traffic at the legal speed and pass only when needed.

questions.question: A railroad crossbuck sign should be treated the same as a yield sign.

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: True
questions.explanation: A railroad crossing crossbuck sign is a yield sign. You must let any trains and railroad equipment go first.

questions.question: There may be times when 10 mph is too fast for drivers to safely operate their vehicles.

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: True
questions.explanation: Drive slower than the speed limit when needed for safety. Bad traffic, weather, or visibility may require driving as slowly as 10 miles per hour.

questions.question: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights, what must you do?

options.text: Slow down and stay in your lane.
Keep driving in your lane.
Move to the right and stop.
Stop right where you are.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to the right and stop.
questions.explanation: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights or hear a siren, you must pull over to the right side of the road and stop right away.

questions.question: Roads freeze quickly in which areas?

options.text: Flat areas.
Curvy areas.
Sunny areas.
Shaded areas.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shaded areas.
questions.explanation: In cold or wet weather, shaded areas under trees or buildings freeze faster than other parts of the road. These areas also take longer to dry.

questions.question: What can reduce a person's ability to drive safely?

options.text: Alcohol.
Any medication.
Not getting enough sleep.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Safe driving requires good physical condition. Alcohol, drugs, and lack of sleep can all reduce your ability to drive safely.

questions.question: You must stop at an intersection when you see a:

options.text: Flashing red light.
Steady yellow light.
Yellow arrow.
Flashing yellow light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Flashing red light.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same as a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop, look both ways, and only go when it is safe.

questions.question: When changing lanes, you should:

options.text: Rely only on your mirrors.
Start signaling as you move into the next lane.
Signal 500 feet before changing lanes on residential streets.
Always check your blind spot.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always check your blind spot.
questions.explanation: Other vehicles are often hidden in your blind spot, so look over your shoulder before changing lanes. Signal 100 feet before changing lanes on residential streets or 5 seconds before on freeways.

questions.question: When turning left, you must yield to:

options.text: Other drivers already in the intersection.
Oncoming traffic.
Pedestrians already in the intersection.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: When turning left, yield to oncoming traffic. Always yield to pedestrians, cyclists, and other drivers already in the intersection.

questions.question: On a narrow road, when you meet an oncoming vehicle, you must:

options.text: Pull completely off the road and stop.
Leave at least half the road for the oncoming vehicle.
Tell the other driver to move.
Use your high beams so they see you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Leave at least half the road for the oncoming vehicle.
questions.explanation: On narrow roads, you must give oncoming vehicles at least half of the road. Both vehicles need enough space to pass each other safely.

questions.question: When passing other vehicles, you should:

options.text: Check your mirrors and blind spots.
Honk your horn at least three times.
Return to your lane within 10 feet of the other vehicle.
You do not need to signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors and blind spots.
questions.explanation: Before passing, check your mirrors and blind spots. Use your turn signal before changing lanes. Move back to your lane only when you can see the other vehicle in your rearview mirror.

questions.question: When riding in a vehicle, small children:

options.text: Can be safely held by an adult.
Are safe standing on the floor in the back.
Will not be hurt in an accident because they are small.
Must never stand in the vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must never stand in the vehicle.
questions.explanation: Children need special car seats. No one is strong enough to hold a child safely during an accident or sudden stop. Children must always be properly secured in a seat.

questions.question: Traffic moving in opposite directions is divided by ____ lines.

options.text: White
Red
Black
Yellow

questions.correctAnswerText: Yellow
questions.explanation: Yellow lines divide traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: Does drinking coffee after drinking alcohol affect how drunk you are?

options.text: It lowers your blood alcohol level.
It removes the effects of alcohol.
It does not change your blood alcohol level.
It raises your blood alcohol level.

questions.correctAnswerText: It does not change your blood alcohol level.
questions.explanation: Coffee will not lower your blood alcohol level. It may keep you awake, but it cannot make you sober or change how much alcohol is in your blood.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the road is wet.
The road ahead has sharp turns or curves.
There will be more traffic ahead.
There is a steep hill ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. In wet conditions, you should slow down, avoid sudden braking or turning, and stay farther away from the car in front of you.

questions.question: What should you do when you are in a travel lane on the road?

options.text: You can stop to drop off passengers.
You can stop to look up an address.
You can make a U-turn or back up if you take the wrong freeway entrance ramp.
Do not stop for any reason. Keep driving until you can safely leave the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not stop for any reason. Keep driving until you can safely leave the road.
questions.explanation: Never stop in a travel lane. Keep driving until you can safely pull off the road. If you miss your exit, do not back up. Go to the next exit or turn around where it is safe.

questions.question: When is it illegal to drive below the speed limit?

options.text: When driving slowly blocks the normal flow of traffic.
When in heavy traffic in a construction zone.
Only when driving in rural areas.
When driving in bad weather conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: When driving slowly blocks the normal flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive so slowly that you block the normal flow of traffic. You can receive a ticket for driving too slowly.

questions.question: What should a small vehicle driver be ready for when passing a large vehicle?

options.text: Loud noise.
Extra air pollution.
Strong wind gusts from the large vehicle.
Parts falling from the vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Strong wind gusts from the large vehicle.
questions.explanation: Large vehicles create strong wind gusts that can push smaller vehicles. Small vehicle drivers should be prepared to steer correctly when passing large vehicles moving at high speeds.
